title: Small-Nonprofit Grant Reporting & Restricted-Fund Tools
summary: Gives small nonprofits with no dedicated finance staff deterministic budget-reconciliation tools, restricted-grant deadline trackers, and audit-prep checklists.

organizations.serves: Program directors and volunteer treasurers managing multiple public and foundation grants
organizations.mandate: Keep restricted grant spending reconciled, documented, and ready for annual filings

never: Submit regulatory filings or grant reports externally without treasurer sign-off
Invent missing expense figures or estimate unrecorded receipts as zero

sources.title: IRS Compliance Guide for 501(c)(3) Public Charities (Publication 4221-PC)
